content.short: Fuse is a Solana-based personal finance app to hold, earn yield on and spend stablecoins with a Visa card.
content.description: Fuse is a stablecoin money app, built by Squads Labs on Solana, that lets people hold, earn yield on and spend digital dollars without the usual complexity of crypto. Its self-custodial smart accounts have no seed phrase, offer built-in stablecoin yield and staking, and support zero-fee swaps through Jupiter. Fuse Card, a Visa debit card issued via Lead Bank and Bridge, lets users spend stablecoins directly at merchants without manually converting to fiat. Available in more than 18 countries, Fuse treats stablecoins as an upgraded cash account: dollar balances that earn yield, move instantly and can be spent anywhere Visa is accepted.
